transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Just having some trouble at work, I guess. When I try to explain things to my team... like the inventory numbers, or the weekend schedule... I don't know, my words just start jumping. I'll go from the delivery trucks, to Thursdays, to the church grill... to my boss's tone. 

People just look at me like they can't follow what I'm saying. So... that's why I'm here.
Aside from the trouble with your speech, have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don't seem to notice?
No. I haven't... no. I don't know what you mean by that. It's really just what I told you... the words getting mixed up. I don't see things.
Have you ever experienced a significant head injury, or been diagnosed with a neurological condition like epilepsy or a brain tumor?
No. I haven't had anything like that. Never hit my head... no seizures or tumors, or anything. Like I said, it's just the talking.
Have you experienced these difficulties with expressing your thoughts since you were a child, or is this a new problem that started recently?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't kept track of it, really. I guess I just notice it now because it's causing issues at work. I'm not sure exactly when it started.
Over the past few years, have you generally felt a persistent sense of sadness, low energy, or hopelessness?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel sad or anything. Just... normal, I guess. Like I said, it's just the trouble at work with the words. That's all.
When you try to write down your thoughts, like in an email or a text message, do you find that your words get mixed up in the same way they do when you are speaking?
I don't... I don't really write that much. Mostly just talking to the staff on the floor. So, no, I haven't really noticed it in emails or anything. Just when I'm speaking.
Have you ever been told by a teacher, a parent, or a doctor that you had a speech or language delay or disorder while you were growing up?
No. Not that I remember. Nobody ever said anything like that to me.
When your team members speak to you, do you find that you sometimes have trouble understanding exactly what they are saying to you?
No... I understand them fine. It's just... when I try to answer. That's the problem. Not what they say to me.

When your words 'jump' like that, is it because you lose your train of thought and switch to a different topic, or is it because you are having trouble physically pronouncing or finding the specific words you want to use?

I don't have trouble pronouncing the words. It's just... the topics change, I guess. Like at work, I'll be trying to explain the inventory numbers, or... the weekend schedule. And it just starts jumping. 

I'll go from talking about the delivery trucks... to Thursdays... then something about the church grill, or my boss's tone of voice. I don't really know how it happens. But people just look at me... like they can't follow what I'm saying at all.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or irritable, perhaps needing much less sleep than usual?
No. I don't think so. I sleep fine... mostly. I'm not really an energetic person.
Have you ever had a distinct period of at least two weeks where you felt severely depressed, to the point where you couldn't function or felt like life wasn't worth living?
No. I haven't had that. I just go to work and come home. I don't feel like that.
When you are around other people, do you often feel very uncomfortable, anxious, or suspicious of their intentions?
No... not really. I mean, I work in a store, so I'm around people all day. I just... I don't really pay much attention to what they're intending. I just do my job.
Do you ever have beliefs or ideas that other people seem to think are strange, such as feeling like you have a special connection to certain events or that things around you have a hidden meaning?
No... I don't have anything like that. I don't really look for hidden meanings in things. I just... manage the floor and go home. Things are just what they are.
Do you generally prefer to spend your free time by yourself rather than socializing with friends or family?
I guess so. I just... I like being at home. I don't really do much else after work. It's just quieter that way.
Outside of your work, do you find that you have trouble completing simple tasks or keeping your daily routine organized because your thoughts jump around?
No, not really. I just... I keep things pretty simple. I get up, go to the store, come home. There's not much to get disorganized about. So... no, I get things done fine.
Do people ever mention that you have unusual habits, dress in a way that stands out, or behave in a way that they find eccentric or odd?
No. People don't really say much to me about how I dress or... what I do. I just wear my work clothes mostly. I don't think I stand out. I just blend in, I guess. Nobody's ever said I was odd.
Do you ever find yourself having very unusual or 'magical' thoughts, such as feeling like you have a 'sixth sense' or that certain coincidences in your life are actually meaningful connections?
No. I don't... I don't really have thoughts like that. A coincidence is just a coincidence. I don't believe in a sixth sense or anything.
